translations.web: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, everyone was weeping and mourning for her. But Jesus said, “Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.”
translations.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
translations.asv: And all were weeping, and bewailing her: but he said, Weep not; for she is not dead, but sleepeth.
